column6: Both paragraphs convey the same theological message that God uplifts rather than brings down individuals, emphasizing a positive relationship with God and the absence of doom and gloom. The differences in wording do not alter the overall meaning.
column7: God never takes you down! He will never run you down; He only builds you up. When God speaks to you, He is speaking from the frame of reference that everything the Word says about you has already been accomplished and ACCEPTED by you. Jeremiah 33:3 says: “Call to Me, and I will answer you, and show you **GREAT AND MIGHTY** things which you do not know.” Does that sound like running you down or doom and gloom? There is NO doom and gloom in God, therefore He cannot tell you anything doomy or gloomy. You’ll have to tune in to the world’s news agency for doom and gloom.
column8: God never brings you down! He will never humiliate you; He only edifies you. When God speaks to you, He speaks from the position that everything the Word says about you is already accomplished and ACCEPTED by you. Jeremiah 33:3 says: “Call to Me, and I will answer you, and show you **GREAT AND MIGHTY** things that you do not know.” Does that sound like putting you down, or like gloom and doom? There is NO gloom and doom in God, so He cannot say anything gloomy or dismal to you. For gloom and doom you’ll have to tune in to the world news agencies.
